title.zh: 方向控制：侧壁由什么决定
title.en: Directional control: what determines the sidewall?

subtitle.zh: 纵向去除、横向去除与晶面差异。
subtitle.en: Vertical removal, lateral removal and crystal-plane differences

body.zh: 核心判断；各向异性描述不同方向刻蚀速率的差别；；“干/湿”分类本身不能决定最终侧壁形状。
body.en: Core assessment Anisotropy describes differences in etch rate across directions; the dry/wet classification alone does not determine final sidewall shape

body.zh: 流程位置；把掩膜开口转成目标层轮廓，为后续填充、隔离或结构释放提供几何形状。
body.en: Position in the flow Convert mask openings into target-layer profiles for subsequent fill, isolation or structural release

body.zh: 1；明确目标轮廓；确定所需的沟槽或；通孔形状
body.en: 1 Define the target profile Define the required trench or via shape

body.zh: 2 检查材料与晶向；确认刻蚀材料；及晶向（如Si（100））
body.en: 2 Check material and crystal orientation Confirm the etched material and orientation (e.g. Si(100))

body.zh: 3；匹配反应和；方向控制机制；选择合适的刻蚀方法；与反应条件
body.en: 3 Match the reaction and directional-control mechanism Choose a suitable etch method and reaction conditions

body.zh: 控制刻蚀深度；达到目标；纵向去除量
body.en: Control etch depth Achieve the target vertical removal

body.zh: 5；比对顶部/底部；尺寸及侧壁；确认关键尺寸；与侧壁形貌
body.en: 5 Compare top/bottom dimensions and sidewalls Verify critical dimensions and sidewall profile

body.zh: 方向性干法（如 RIE）；近乎直壁；Si；示例：Cl₂ / HBr；等离子体刻蚀硅
body.en: Directional dry etch (e.g. RIE) Nearly vertical sidewalls Si Example: Cl₂ / HBr plasma etching of silicon

body.zh: 各向同性刻蚀；侧向同时去除；Si；示例：XeF₂气相；刻蚀硅（干法，各向同性）
body.en: Isotropic etching Lateral removal occurs simultaneously Si Example: XeF₂ gas-phase silicon etching (dry, isotropic)

body.zh: 晶面选择性湿法；斜壁（受晶向控制）；（111）；（111）；Si（100）；示例：KOH 溶液；刻单晶硅（湿法，晶面控制）
body.en: Crystal-plane-selective wet etching Sloping walls (controlled by orientation) (111) (111) Si(100) Example: KOH solution etching single-crystal silicon (wet, crystal-plane controlled)

body.zh: 关键控制；纵向深度；横向退缩；侧壁角度；θ；掩膜尺寸损失
body.en: Key controls Vertical depth Lateral recession Sidewall angle θ Mask dimensional loss

body.zh: 耦合与失效；• 在依赖钝化的方向性干法中，侧壁保护不足会；增加侧蚀，过强可能造成开口收缩或底部难刻。；• 深窄结构还可能出现与宽开口不同的刻蚀深度。
body.en: Coupling and failure • In directional dry etching that relies on passivation, insufficient sidewall protection increases lateral etch, while excessive protection can narrow openings or hinder bottom etching • Deep, narrow structures may also etch to different depths from wide openings

body.zh: 下游影响与边界；• 轮廓偏差可能带来填充空洞；或有效尺寸变化。；• XeF₂气相刻硅可各向同性；去除；KOH 刻单晶硅可形成；晶面控制的斜壁，该斜壁；不等同于 RIE的方向性直壁。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries • Profile deviations may cause fill voids or changes in effective dimensions • XeF₂ gas-phase silicon etching can remove isotropically; KOH etching of single-crystal silicon can form crystal-plane-controlled slopes; these sloped walls are not equivalent to directional RIE vertical walls

body.zh: 量测反馈；• 用截面 SEM检查；侧壁与底部。；• 用CD 量测比较；刻前刻后关键尺寸。；• 按开口宽度分组；判断形貌偏差。
body.en: Metrology feedback • Use cross-sectional SEM to inspect sidewalls and the bottom • Compare critical dimensions before and after etching by CD metrology • Group by opening width to assess profile deviations

body.zh: 量测结果反馈，优化工艺条件
body.en: Feed metrology results back to optimize process conditions

body.zh: 典型侧壁形貌及决定因素
body.en: Typical sidewall profiles and their determinants
